rationale: Post-remediation sampling shows the prior high-severity gaps closed on merit: worker.zip byte-matches src, lab digest pins match the packaged tar across release-contract and Helm values, a schema-valid synthetic restore-verification event exists and is indexed, and STATUS/PLAN/claims docs no longer falsely assert Stage-2 complete. Residual medium issues are authority pin drift (plan-approval still build-orchestration; accuracy-final stale), evidence SHA lag behind HEAD, and synthetic/draft-cloud honesty — disclosed and appropriate for a repo-only lab, not blockers to merging this ContinuityOps scaffold.
